newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium/Lux 1996 c/a surplus revised down.
newsitem.headline: Belgium/Lux 1996 c/a surplus revised down.

text.p: The National Bank of Belgium (NBB) said on Friday it had revised down its estimate of the 1996 current account surplus of the Belgium Luxembourg Economic Union (BLEU) to 387 from 391 billion Belgian francs.
The 1995 surplus had been revised up to 351 from 346 billion francs, the central bank said in its weekly economic indicators publication.

The current account is a measure of a country's financial position with the rest of the world, measuring trade in goods and services. Belgium and Luxembourg have been joined in a currency union since the 1920s.
